By moving from edge devices to robust data centers, enterprises gain increased processing capabilities and efficiency. The core advantage here is scalability. Edge devices are great for localized tasks but hit limits when processing demands grow. Transitioning to data centers powered by liquid cooling, as xFusion demonstrates, offers a more robust solution for complex AI workloads. Of course, this kind of infrastructure isn't cheap.
